posts.topic_title: SURVEY: Who makes what type of hologram?
posts.author: twilightwindow
posts.post_subject: SURVEY: Who makes what type of hologram?
posts.content_md:
I'm curious about the **most popular type of hologram**made by group members. Is it

(A) reflection holograms (Denisyuk)

(B) laser transmissions

(C) rainbow 

(D) image plane

(C) and (D) are nearly always H2, but does anyone here do 1-step rainbows or image planes?

posts.topic_title: SURVEY: Who makes what type of hologram?
posts.author: Dinesh
posts.post_subject: SURVEY: Who makes what type of hologram?
posts.content_md:
We do mostly H1 on Silver (Slavich VRP-M) and H2 on DCG. We've done H2 on Silver as well, but I like DCG because you don't need a light to reconstruct. Well, you do, but they show up fine in standard room lights.

We've done achromats and rainbows on Silver. Colin and I did a rainbow on DCG. But mostly it's H1 on Silver and H2 on DCG.

posts.topic_title: SURVEY: Who makes what type of hologram?
posts.author: tpark
posts.post_subject: SURVEY: Who makes what type of hologram?
posts.content_md: I make mostly transmission holograms on PFG-03M, although I've made a fairly large number of other types. I've done a fair number of reflection holograms, and some copying (focused image). I'm really pretty much in the learning phase of holography, so I haven't tried anything too elaborate yet.

posts.topic_title: SURVEY: Who makes what type of hologram?
posts.author: MichaelH
posts.post_subject: SURVEY: Who makes what type of hologram?
posts.content_md:
I see a difference between "most popular" and the ones I make most often so I'll answer both questions.

The most popular (IE, ones I like the most) are transmission. Can't beat the depth and speckly goodness.

The ones I make most frequently are H2 reflections on silver from silver transmission masters.
